SELECT 
    content_key,
    (
        CASE WHEN tiernotices->'free_tier'->>'Alert_Note' IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN tiernotices->'member_tier'->>'Alert_Note' IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN tiernotices->'free_tier'->>'Avail_Note' IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN tiernotices->'member_tier'->>'Avail_Note' IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN tiernotices->'free_tier'->>'Promo_Note' IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN tiernotices->'member_tier'->>'Promo_Note' IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN tiernotices->'free_tier'->>'Expire_Note' IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN tiernotices->'member_tier'->>'Expire_Note' IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    )::numeric / 8.0 as psr
FROM promo_info
ORDER BY psr DESC
LIMIT 5;
